scripts.initialize: pnpm --filter ctool-config run build && pnpm --filter ctool-adapter-base run build && pnpm -r run adapter-build
scripts.test: pnpm run initialize && pnpm --filter ctool-core run test
scripts.check: pnpm run initialize && pnpm --filter ctool-core run check
scripts.dev: pnpm run initialize && pnpm --filter ctool-core run dev
scripts.build: pnpm run initialize && pnpm --filter ctool-core run build
scripts.deploy:cloudflare: pnpm run build && pnpm --filter ctool-adapter-web exec cf deploy
scripts.deploy:cloudflare:check: pnpm run build && pnpm --filter ctool-adapter-web exec cf deploy --dry-run
scripts.release: node release.cjs && pnpm run build && pnpm -r run platform-release
scripts.vercel-build: pnpm run build && pnpm --filter ctool-site run build
scripts.build:extension: pnpm run initialize && pnpm --filter ctool-core run check && pnpm --filter ctool-core exec vite build && tsup --config tsup.extension.config.ts && node scripts/assemble.mjs
scripts.check:duplicates: jscpd packages/ctool-core/src packages/ctool-config/src packages/ctool-tools/src service tests scripts --baseline .jscpd-baseline.json --fail-on-new-clones 0 --fail-on-empty --min-tokens 100 --ignore "**/buildDataTemp*,**/tools/asn1/lib/**,**/tools/qrCode/lib/**,**/xhub.d.ts" --reporters json --output .cache/duplicates
scripts.verify: pnpm run check && pnpm run check:service && pnpm run lint && pnpm run test && pnpm run build:extension && pnpm run test:contract && pnpm run test:package && pnpm run test:e2e && pnpm run check:duplicates
scripts.check:service: tsc --noEmit --target ES2022 --module ESNext --moduleResolution bundler --esModuleInterop --strict --skipLibCheck service/main.ts service/network.ts
